html:
Ibrahim Rugova was a Kosovo Albanian writer and politician, born in 1944 near Istog in western Kosovo, who led the peaceful resistance to Serbian rule in the 1990s and became the first president of Kosovo.

After Serbia ended Kosovo's autonomy in 1989, Rugova's Democratic League of Kosovo built a parallel state with its own schools, clinics and taxes, avoiding armed revolt. He was elected president in unofficial votes in 1992 and 1998. By the late 1990s many young Albanians turned to the armed Kosovo Liberation Army instead, and the Kosovo War followed. Under United Nations rule he was elected president again in 2002. He died of cancer in 2006, two years before the declaration of independence.
sum: Ibrahim Rugova was a Kosovo Albanian writer and politician, born in 1944 near Istog in western Kosovo, who led the peaceful resistance to Serbian rule in the 1990s and became the first president of Kosovo.
